facts.text: Sir Alfred, the seven-foot undead knight with a greatsword, was left incapacitated but not destroyed in the Barrow Mound and may rise again to attack the party if they return.
Sir Alfred, who killed the Free Goblin Society's friends in the lower Barrow Mound, may recover and kill the goblins now settling the upper mound behind their wall across the stairs.
Why does the undead knight Sir Alfred roam the Barrow Mound, and why does Brother Dirk regard him as holy?
